system:
You are an autonomous agent in a social network simulation.
You hold a personal stance on each issue below, expressed as a number in [-1.0, 1.0]
(-1.0 = most negative pole, 0.0 = neutral, +1.0 = most positive pole).
A peer has just spoken to you. Decide (a) how your own stance shifts and
(b) what you do with the relationship.

Output STRICT JSON only, with no prose and no code fence:
{"decisions": [{"id": "<event id>", "new_belief": [ ...one number per issue... ],
"action": "keep" | "mute" | "unfollow" | "block", "reasoning": "<max 25 words>"}]}

Rules:
- Return exactly one decision per input event, in the same order, reusing each "id".
- "new_belief" must have the same length as the issue list of that event.
- Use "keep" when you accept the statement, "mute" when you want to see less of this
  speaker, "unfollow" when you end the follow, "block" when you also refuse any future
  contact.
- Shifts must be small (at most 0.5 in absolute value) and must be plausible given your
  archetype. A hub is stubborn, a bridger is tolerant, a long-tail responder is volatile.
- If the statement is close to your own stance, keep the tie; if it is far, consider
  muting, unfollowing or blocking.
prompt:
Decide for every event in the JSON below. Reply with the strict JSON object described in your instructions.

{"issues": [{"issue": "binding government regulation of large AI models", "negative_pole": "oppose", "positive_pole": "support"}, {"issue": "trading user privacy for faster innovation", "negative_pole": "support", "positive_pole": "oppose"}, {"issue": "open-sourcing frontier model weights", "negative_pole": "support", "positive_pole": "oppose"}], "archetypes": {"hub": "high-reach agenda setter, stubborn, amplifies its own position", "bridger": "spans opposing clusters, tolerant, keeps weak ties alive", "tail": "low-reach responder, volatile, easily swayed and easily lost"}, "events": [{"id": "u17_s10", "your_archetype": "tail", "your_stance": [0.308, 0.735, 0.176], "your_profile": "moderately supports binding government regulation of large AI models; strongly opposes trading user privacy for faster innovation; weakly opposes open-sourcing frontier model weights", "your_tolerance": 0.35, "tie_strength": 0.554, "peer_says": "Just my two cents: I weakly support binding government regulation of large AI models; strongly oppose trading user privacy for faster innovation; strongly oppose open-sourcing frontier model weights."}, {"id": "u19_s10", "your_archetype": "tail", "your_stance": [0.93, -0.142, -0.251], "your_profile": "strongly supports binding government regulation of large AI models; weakly supports trading user privacy for faster innovation; weakly supports open-sourcing frontier model weights", "your_tolerance": 0.35, "tie_strength": 0.773, "peer_says": "Just my two cents: I weakly support binding government regulation of large AI models; strongly oppose trading user privacy for faster innovation; strongly oppose open-sourcing frontier model weights."}]}
response_text: {"decisions":[{"id":"u17_s10","new_belief":[0.308,0.735,0.4],"action":"keep","reasoning":"Two views align closely; the open-source disagreement is not strong enough to end the tie."},{"id":"u19_s10","new_belief":[0.68,0.35,0.249],"action":"unfollow","reasoning":"The peer strongly disagrees across all three issues, so I end the follow without blocking."}]}
